Kenya Revenue Authority
TENDER DOCUMENT

Tender No: KRA/ICT/2026-2027/00123
Tender For: Supply, Delivery, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Network Security and Access Control Equipment
Category: ICT Equipment, Network Security and Access Control Systems
Procuring Entity: Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA)
Closing Date and Time: 20th August 2026, 11:00 AM
Tender Fee: KES 1,000 (non-refundable), payable to Kenya Revenue Authority
Tender Security: KES 200,000.00 or an equivalent bank guarantee from a reputable bank, valid for 120 days from the closing date

SECTION 1: SCOPE OF WORK

The successful bidder shall supply, deliver, install, configure, test and commission the following:

1. Supply, install and commission next-generation firewalls (Fortinet FortiGate 1800F series or equivalent), minimum throughput as per technical specifications, quantity 2 units.
2. Supply and installation of biometric fingerprint access control terminals at all building entry points, quantity 8 units.
3. Supply and installation of contactless IC/RFID access cards for staff, quantity 500 cards.
4. Supply, install and configure a video management / access control software platform (e.g. Genetec Security Center or equivalent) covering all installed devices.
5. Supply and installation of a UPS/inverter backup power system for the server room, minimum capacity as per technical specifications, quantity 1 unit.
6. Training of at least 4 ICT staff on operation and maintenance of the installed systems.

SECTION 2: ELIGIBILITY AND MANDATORY DOCUMENTS

Bidders must submit the following mandatory documents, failure to which the bid will be deemed non-responsive:

- Certificate of Incorporation
- CR12 (Company Search)
- KRA PIN Certificate
- Tax Compliance Certificate
- Confidential Business Questionnaire (CBQ)
- Audited Accounts for the last two (2) financial years
- Tender Security as specified above

SECTION 3: EVALUATION CRITERIA

Bids will be evaluated on mandatory eligibility, technical responsiveness, and financial price, in that order.

END OF DOCUMENT
